full_prompt_en: The square image is an anime-style illustration of a young girl with large brown eyes, framed from the waist upward against a warm brown and cream background. She is positioned slightly right of centre, her head and gaze turned a little toward the left. Her dark brown hair is loosely gathered into short side bunches, with loose bangs curving across her forehead and a few wisps extending beside her cheeks. The eyes are large and softly shaded, with dark pupils and small highlights; her small mouth remains closed and her expression is quiet. A pale tan scarf wraps around her neck, tucked beneath a cream blouse with full sleeves and visible folds at the elbows and cuffs. Over the blouse she wears a dark brown fitted dress with a bodice, its broad straps running over the shoulders and joining a simple front panel. Behind her, two enormous pale feathered wings spread outward, one filling much of the left side and the other extending behind her right shoulder. The wing surfaces are built from layered ivory and warm grey feathers, each marked by fine brown lines. Their broad arcs frame the head and upper body without obscuring the face. The background is divided into warm ochre, dark umber and cream patches, with darker areas behind the wings and lighter open space around the shoulders. No distinct room or landscape is visible. The girl’s lower body is cropped by the bottom edge, while the wing tips extend beyond the side boundaries. Light is soft and warm, strongest across the face, blouse and inner feather surfaces; gentle shadows define the scarf folds and the dark bodice. Fine brown outlines and broad shaded patches define the face, hair and clothing; worn, mottled paint texture remains visible across the warm background. The pale wings extend beyond the figure’s shoulders and occupy nearly the full width behind her. Their feather lines radiate outward from points near the back, with the left wing opening against a darker brown area and the right wing partly disappearing into cream. The fitted bodice stays darker than the blouse, making the layered clothing easy to distinguish. The short ponytails lift slightly away from the head, while the loose fringe follows the curve of her forehead. The face remains unobstructed at the centre of the wing shapes. The overall composition centres the small figure between expansive wings, balancing light feather shapes with the darker clothing and warm, quiet background.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的动漫风格插画，描绘一位棕发少女，取景至腰部以上，背景由暖棕色与奶油白色构成。她位于画面略偏右的位置，头部与目光稍稍转向左侧。深棕色头发在两侧松松收成短发束，松散刘海弯过额头，面颊旁还有几缕发丝。她的棕色大眼睛带柔和阴影，瞳孔深色并有小高光；小嘴闭合，神情安静。浅棕色围巾绕在颈部，塞在奶油白衬衫之下；衬衫袖子宽松，肘部和袖口处能看到褶皱。外面穿一件深棕色合身的束身衣裙，宽肩带搭过肩膀并连接到简洁的前片。她身后展开两只巨大的浅色羽翼，一只占据左侧大部，另一只从右肩后方向外延伸。羽翼由层叠象牙白与暖灰色羽毛构成，每片羽毛都有细棕线痕。宽阔弧形翼面围住头部和上身，却没有遮住面孔。背景分成暖赭、深棕和奶油白色块，羽翼后方较暗，肩部周围留有浅色空间。看不出明确房间或风景。少女下半身被画面底缘裁切，翼尖则延伸到左右画框之外。光线柔和温暖，面部、衬衫和羽翼内侧最亮；围巾褶皱和深色衣身处有轻浅阴影。细棕色轮廓线与宽阔阴影块面界定面部、头发和衣着；温暖背景中仍可见旧化斑驳的绘画肌理。浅色羽翼从少女肩后向外伸展，几乎占据她身后的整个画面宽度。羽毛线条从背部附近向外放射，左翼在深棕区域前展开，右翼则有部分融入奶油白背景。束身衣裙比衬衫颜色更深，使层叠衣着容易区分。两束短马尾从头部两侧微微翘起，松散刘海沿额头弧线落下。面孔完整露在羽翼形体的中央，没有被遮挡。整体构图把娇小身影置于宽阔羽翼之间，以浅色羽毛平衡深色衣服和温暖安静的背景。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration treatment combines fine brown contours, simplified rounded forms and broad, softly joined shadow shapes. Warm umber, ochre, cream and muted ivory create a subdued palette, with dark accents clarifying the main silhouettes. Repeated tapered lines describe fine surface detail, while wider irregular marks give larger colour areas a worn, hand-painted texture. Mottled background layers alternate between deep brown and pale warm passages, keeping the focal arrangement legible without a polished digital finish. Soft light gathers on lighter planes and recedes gradually into the darker masses. The overall treatment balances delicate linework, aged colour texture and a quiet, restrained warmth.
style_prompt_zh: 动漫插画处理结合细棕轮廓线、简化圆润形体和柔和衔接的宽阔阴影块。暖棕、赭色、奶油白与低饱和象牙色形成含蓄配色，深色强调帮助辨认主要剪影。重复的尖细线条表现细微表面结构，较宽的不规则痕迹则让大色域带有旧化的手绘肌理。斑驳背景图层在深棕和浅暖色之间交替，使焦点布局清晰，却没有光滑抛光的数字效果。柔光聚集在较浅平面上，再逐渐退入暗块。整体处理在纤细线条、旧化色彩肌理与安静克制的暖意之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Brown-haired girl in cream and brown clothing between large pale wings
theme_zh: 浅色巨翼之间穿奶白与棕色衣裙的棕发少女
name: Haibane Renmei
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
